### 1.1 Reuse of existing work

Every screen, component and flow, checked against the Acies Power Apps reuse catalogue and PROJECT.md §8.
`/scaffold`, `/ui-dev`, `/functionality-dev` and `/flows` read the code named here before writing their own.

Catalogue checked at: `<commit>` on `<date>` (or: not reachable, and why)

| Piece | Catalogue entry or reference (repository @ commit, path) | Reuse | Why | What changes to meet our standards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| scrApprovals | `approval-screen`: `Acies-Innovations/<repo> @ 3f2a9c1`, `canvas/<App>/Src/scrApprovals.pa.yaml` | Adapt code | Same gallery, approve and reject; Acies-owned; pac and Studio match PROJECT.md §1 | Hex colours → tokens (D11); list names → this project's data-source variables |
| conHeader | — | No match | Nothing in the catalogue has a floating top bar with pill tabs | — |
| — | `old-flow`: `<repo> @ 9e1d0b4` | Not used | Uses a connector outside `allowedConnectors` (D2) | — |

Reuse is **Pattern** (read for the approach, write new code), **Adapt code** (start from its files,
bring them to standard), **No match** or **Not used**.
